rem Rounded Square Roots
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=255
rem Find the average number of
rem iterations of x -> (x + ceil(n / x))
rem // 2, from the start 2 10^((d -
rem 1)/2) for odd d and 7 10^((d - 2)/2)
rem for even d, until x stops changing,
rem over the n with d digits

use numbers
use io
use cli

arg Digits integer = 14

rem Group the n. Those with the same x
rem at some step form an interval, and
rem ceil(n / x) = c on a sub-interval,
rem with the next x = (x + c) // 2. A
rem group finishes when the next x
rem equals x, and adds its size times
rem the steps taken. The first step is a
rem loop over the next x, each then
rem followed depth first on a small
rem stack.
First = 10 ** (Digits - 1)
Last = 10 ** Digits - 1
X0 = 7 * 10 ** (Digits // 2 - 1)
if Digits mod 2 equal 1
  X0 = 2 * 10 ** (Digits // 2)
end
Cap = 400
Sx = array shape Cap fill 0
Sl = array shape Cap fill 0
Sh = array shape Cap fill 0
Sk = array shape Cap fill 0
Total = 0
C = (First + X0 - 1) // X0
Cend = (Last + X0 - 1) // X0
for
  if C greater Cend
    break
  end
  Y = (X0 + C) // 2
  C2 = 2 * Y + 1 - X0
  if Cend less C2
    C2 = Cend
  end
  Nlo = (C - 1) * X0 + 1
  if First greater Nlo
    Nlo = First
  end
  Nhi = C2 * X0
  if Last less Nhi
    Nhi = Last
  end
  Size = Nhi - Nlo + 1
  if Y equal X0
    Total += Size
  else
    Sx 0 = Y
    Sl 0 = Nlo
    Sh 0 = Nhi
    Sk 0 = 1
    Top = 1
    for
      if Top equal 0
        break
      end
      Top -= 1
      X = Sx Top
      Lo = Sl Top
      Hi = Sh Top
      K = Sk Top
      D1 = (Lo + X - 1) // X
      D2 = (Hi + X - 1) // X
      D = D1
      for
        if D greater D2
          break
        end
        Z = (X + D) // 2
        D3 = 2 * Z + 1 - X
        if D2 less D3
          D3 = D2
        end
        Mlo = (D - 1) * X + 1
        if Lo greater Mlo
          Mlo = Lo
        end
        Mhi = D3 * X
        if Hi less Mhi
          Mhi = Hi
        end
        Count = Mhi - Mlo + 1
        if Z equal X
          Total += Count * (K + 1)
        else
          Sx Top = Z
          Sl Top = Mlo
          Sh Top = Mhi
          Sk Top = K + 1
          Top += 1
        end
        D = D3 + 1
      end
    end
  end
  C = C2 + 1
end
Count = Last - First + 1
Answer = Total / Count round 10
Answer print

use io
use cli

rem each time a group is visited. After
rem the first step, x is at least the

rem keep only its siblings on the stack.

Last = 10 ** Digits - 1
X0 = 2 * 10 ** (Digits // 2)

  X0 = 7 * 10 ** (Digits // 2 - 1)

    break
  end

      Bound = X * (X - 1)
